# Pico Engine docs (llms.txt)

Machine-readable index for agents working with picos and KRL.

## Start here

- Local dev: `npm install -g pico-engine` then `pico-engine` (or repo `npm start`)
- Agent loop: repo `CLAUDE.md` + `pico-engine mcp --stdio` (see packages/pico-engine/README.md)
- Validate KRL: `krl-check` / `npm run krl-check`

## Docs

- Pico overview: pico-overview.md
- Pico engine operator guide: pico-engine.md
- Bundled rulesets: rulesets/README.md
- KRL manual: krl/README.md
- Contributing: contributing.md

## Bundled ruleset API (generated from KRL)

- io.picolabs.wrangler: rulesets/io.picolabs.wrangler.md
- io.picolabs.pds: rulesets/io.picolabs.pds.md
- io.picolabs.subscription: rulesets/io.picolabs.subscription.md
- io.picolabs.pico-engine-ui: rulesets/io.picolabs.pico-engine-ui.md
- io.picolabs.oauth: rulesets/io.picolabs.oauth.md
- io.picolabs.portable_subtree: rulesets/io.picolabs.portable_subtree.md

## Manifold (mesh framework — separate repo)

Application layer on wrangler (owner, thing, community). Not shipped inside pico-engine.
- Index: https://github.com/Picolab/manifold-api/blob/main/docs/llms.txt
- Generated ruleset APIs: https://github.com/Picolab/manifold-api/tree/main/docs/rulesets


## OpenAPI

- Sky and channel HTTP: public/docs/openapi.yaml
